description: This file defines the AuthSelectionMiddleware class, which is responsible for selecting and applying the appropriate authentication scheme within the AWS SDK for PHP. It handles middleware wrapping, auth scheme resolution, and integrates with command execution flow.

classes.name: AuthSelectionMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class responsible for automating auth scheme resolution and application during AWS SDK command execution.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Static method that creates a middleware wrapper function for integrating auth scheme resolution into the request pipeline.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the middleware with the next handler, auth resolver, and service metadata.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Executes the middleware logic: selecting an auth scheme based on service and operation metadata, and applying it to the command context.
